c1-gen-0062: Night fell, and a vision came to Abram after the battle. Hear the LORD speak in Genesis 15:1.
c2-gen-0021: The world was brand new, full of birds and beasts. See what God hands out in Genesis 1:29 and Genesis 1:30.
c2-gen-0022: A father and son climbed the mountain side by side. Walk with them through Genesis 22:8 and Genesis 22:14.
c2-gen-0023: Colors arched across the clouds after the flood. Hear God's words in Genesis 9:15 and Genesis 9:16.
c3-gen-0003: Old Jacob gathered his sons around his bed. Listen as he speaks over Judah in Genesis 49:8 and Genesis 49:10.
c3-gen-0004: Abram looked up at a sky full of stars. Later the promise came again, so compare Genesis 15:5 with Genesis 22:17.
c3-gen-0005: God spoke a promise to Abram, then spoke it once more years later. Put Genesis 12:3 beside Genesis 22:18.
c3-gen-0006: From the garden to the mountain, God kept speaking of the days ahead. Look at Genesis 3:15, then Genesis 22:17.
c1-gen-0063: The herdsmen were arguing, and the land felt crowded. Listen to Abram's words to Lot in Genesis 13:8.
c2-gen-0024: The king of Sodom offered Abram a deal after the battle. Find Abram's answer in Genesis 14:22 and Genesis 14:23.
c2-gen-0025: A king and priest came out to meet Abram with bread and wine. Discover more in Genesis 14:18 and Genesis 14:20.
c2-gen-0026: Jacob woke up to a big surprise on the morning after his wedding. Hear Laban in Genesis 29:25 and Genesis 29:26.
c3-gen-0007: Jacob's family packed up for the trip to Bethel. Follow them in Genesis 35:2, Genesis 35:4, and Genesis 35:5.
c3-gen-0008: God made big promises to Jacob, and long before, to Abraham. Compare Genesis 17:16 with Genesis 35:11.
c3-gen-0009: Three women waited a long time for a baby. Read about each in Genesis 11:30, Genesis 25:21, and Genesis 30:22.
c3-gen-0010: Two brothers had a rough start long ago. See where their story lands in Genesis 25:33, Genesis 25:34, and Genesis 35:29.
c1-exo-0022: At the mountain, God reminded Israel of their trip out of Egypt. Listen to Him in Exodus 19:4.
c2-exo-0019: Thunder rolled and a trumpet blasted at the mountain. Moses spoke to the frightened people in Exodus 20:20.
c2-exo-0020: The people stood far back from the dark cloud. See where Moses went in Exodus 20:19 and Exodus 20:21.
c2-exo-0021: An ox has wandered off down the road, and it belongs to someone unkind. Check Exodus 23:4 and Exodus 23:5.
c3-exo-0003: The land ahead was wide, with many peoples living in it. God explains His plan in Exodus 23:29 and Exodus 23:30.
c3-exo-0004: Israel remembered being strangers in Egypt long ago. Set Exodus 22:21 next to Exodus 23:9.
c3-exo-0005: At the mountain, the people made a promise, then made it again later. Hear them in Exodus 19:8 and Exodus 24:7.
c3-exo-0006: God spoke to Israel about listening to His voice. Listen to both promises in Exodus 19:5 and Exodus 23:22.
c1-lev-0003: Every fiftieth year was a special year in Israel. Find out what rang out in Leviticus 25:10.
c2-lev-0007: What would the people eat when the fields took a break? God answers in Leviticus 25:20 and Leviticus 25:21.
c2-lev-0008: Families in Israel cared about their land. God gives His reason in Leviticus 25:23 and Leviticus 25:24.
c2-lev-0009: Merchants weighed grain on their scales at the market. Listen to God's words in Leviticus 19:35 and Leviticus 19:36.
c3-lev-0001: Each Sabbath, fresh loaves were set out in rows before the LORD. Look at Leviticus 24:8 and Leviticus 24:9.
c3-lev-0002: A gray-haired neighbor walks by, and a poor brother needs help. Learn how God wants both treated in Leviticus 19:32 and Leviticus 25:36.
c3-lev-0003: Every seventh year, the fields were meant to get a break. See what comes in Leviticus 25:4, Leviticus 26:34, and Leviticus 26:35.
c3-lev-0004: Some people in Israel were far from home, and some had become poor. Read Leviticus 19:34 and Leviticus 25:35.
c1-num-0003: On Mount Hor, Moses and Aaron climbed up with one more person. Stay with them in Numbers 20:26 and Numbers 20:28.
c2-num-0008: Joshua ran to Moses, worried about two men in the camp. Hear Moses answer in Numbers 11:28 and Numbers 11:29.
c2-num-0009: Miriam and Aaron spoke up against their brother. Look closely at Numbers 12:2 and Numbers 12:3.
c2-num-0010: Sickness was spreading through the camp, and Aaron ran with incense. Follow him in Numbers 16:47 and Numbers 16:48.
c3-num-0001: Korah's group said some sharp words to Moses. See how Moses answered in Numbers 16:3 and Numbers 16:7.
c3-num-0002: Twelve staffs were laid out overnight in the tent. See what happened by morning in Numbers 16:5, Numbers 17:5, and Numbers 17:8.
c3-num-0003: Moses carried a big load, and God gave him help. See how the help was shared in Numbers 11:17 and Numbers 27:20.
c3-num-0004: Twice Moses and Aaron called on God by a special name. Find it in Numbers 16:22 and Numbers 27:16.
c1-deu-0005: Moses died in the land of Moab, and God took care of him. Read Deuteronomy 34:6.
c2-deu-0013: Moses gave the judges a job that took courage. His reason is in Deuteronomy 1:17.
c2-deu-0014: Moses longed to cross the river and see the land. The LORD answers him in Deuteronomy 3:25 and Deuteronomy 3:26.
c2-deu-0015: Israel was a small nation among many big ones. Moses explains why God chose them in Deuteronomy 7:7 and Deuteronomy 7:8.
c3-deu-0001: In Egypt, farmers carried water to their crops. Look at the new land in Deuteronomy 11:10 and Deuteronomy 11:11.
c3-deu-0002: One day Israel would have a king, and he'd need the law close by. See Deuteronomy 17:18, Deuteronomy 17:20, and Deuteronomy 31:9.
c3-deu-0003: Moses stood high on Pisgah, looking west across the Jordan. Stand on the mountain with Moses in Deuteronomy 3:27 and Deuteronomy 34:4.
c3-deu-0004: Moms and dads were to share God's words at home. See why in Deuteronomy 11:19 and Deuteronomy 31:13.
c1-1ch-0001: The sad story of King Saul comes to an end. Find the reason given in First Chronicles 10:13 and First Chronicles 10:14.
c2-1ch-0001: David sat in his cedar house, thinking about the ark. See what Nathan said in First Chronicles 17:1 and First Chronicles 17:2.
c2-1ch-0002: David wanted to build a house for God, but the answer was not yet. Listen in First Chronicles 22:8 and First Chronicles 22:9.
c2-1ch-0003: David had a tough choice to make, and Gad waited for his answer. Hear David in First Chronicles 21:12 and First Chronicles 21:13.
c3-1ch-0001: Fire came down from heaven onto David's altar. Watch the angel in First Chronicles 21:26 and First Chronicles 21:27.
c3-1ch-0002: David had gathered gold, silver, bronze, and iron for the temple. Listen to his prayer in First Chronicles 22:14 and First Chronicles 29:14.
c3-1ch-0003: David dreamed of building God a house for many years. Hear the answer God gave David in First Chronicles 17:4 and First Chronicles 28:3.
c3-1ch-0004: David spoke to his son Solomon, then prayed before all the people. Listen to a father's words in First Chronicles 28:9 and First Chronicles 29:17.
c1-1ch-0002: The city of the Jebusites stood strong on its hill. Find out who went first in First Chronicles 11:6.
c2-1ch-0004: Three brave men slipped past the enemy to fetch David a drink. Find out what David did in First Chronicles 11:18 and First Chronicles 11:19.
c2-1ch-0005: Day after day, more men joined David's army. Read about one tribe in First Chronicles 12:22 and First Chronicles 12:32.
c2-1ch-0006: The ark was on the move, and David felt afraid. Find where it stopped in First Chronicles 13:13 and First Chronicles 13:14.
c3-1ch-0005: Two brothers led Israel's army into battle against two enemies at once. Hear their plan in First Chronicles 19:12 and First Chronicles 19:13.
c3-1ch-0006: David wanted the ark brought home, but the first try failed. See what was missed in First Chronicles 13:3 and First Chronicles 15:13.
c3-1ch-0007: The ark traveled twice to Jerusalem, in two different ways. Notice the two ways the ark traveled in First Chronicles 13:7 and First Chronicles 15:15.
c3-1ch-0008: David's kingdom became strong, and the LORD was with him. Discover more about David's victories in First Chronicles 11:9 and First Chronicles 18:6.
c1-2ch-0001: A huge army was marching toward Judah, and everyone gathered to pray. Listen to Jahaziel in Second Chronicles 20:15.
c2-2ch-0002: All Israel crowded into the temple court. Picture King Solomon there in Second Chronicles 6:12 and Second Chronicles 6:13.
c2-2ch-0003: King Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he turned to the LORD. Listen to a worried king's prayer in Second Chronicles 20:3 and Second Chronicles 20:12.
c2-2ch-0004: Early one day, Judah marched out toward the Wilderness of Tekoa. Listen to the king in Second Chronicles 20:20 and Second Chronicles 20:21.
c3-2ch-0001: A giant army came against King Asa. Hear Asa call out to the LORD in Second Chronicles 14:6 and Second Chronicles 14:11.
c3-2ch-0002: Long before the temple fell, God gave Solomon a warning. Hold the two side by side in Second Chronicles 7:20 and Second Chronicles 36:19.
c3-2ch-0003: King Manasseh was in chains, far from home, and he prayed. Compare Second Chronicles 7:14 with Second Chronicles 33:12 and Second Chronicles 33:13.
c3-2ch-0004: Two kings prayed for Israel, many years apart. See how both prayers were heard in Second Chronicles 6:21 and Second Chronicles 30:20.
c1-2ch-0002: Josiah was just a young king when something new began in him. Meet the young king in Second Chronicles 34:3.
c2-2ki-0016: Workers were fixing up the temple, and money was changing hands. Hear Josiah's reason in Second Kings 22:7.
c2-2ch-0005: A lost book was found in the temple, and Josiah wanted to know more. Follow his helpers in Second Chronicles 34:21 and Second Chronicles 34:22.
c2-2ki-0017: The whole town packed into the temple to hear the book read aloud. Watch the king in Second Kings 23:2 and Second Kings 23:3.
c3-2ch-0005: Passover was coming, and Josiah gave the Levites a new job. Hear him in Second Chronicles 35:2 and Second Chronicles 35:3.
c3-2ki-0001: Josiah never turned to the right or to the left. Learn more about Josiah's whole heart in Second Kings 22:2 and Second Kings 23:25.
c3-2ki-0002: Josiah cleaned up the land, yet his heart was heavy. Follow his story in Second Kings 22:13 and Second Kings 23:26.
c3-2ch-0006: Josiah made a promise to the LORD, and then a big feast followed. See Second Chronicles 34:31 and Second Chronicles 35:18.
c1-ecc-0001: Picture friends standing close, ready to help each other. The Preacher speaks in Ecclesiastes 4:12.
c2-ecc-0001: Rivers rush down to the sea, day after day. The Preacher looks at this in Ecclesiastes 1:7.
c2-ecc-0002: There is a time for everything under the sun. Hear the Preacher speak about God's work in Ecclesiastes 3:1 and Ecclesiastes 3:11.
c2-ecc-0003: Before we speak to God, it's good to stop and think. The Preacher explains in Ecclesiastes 5:2 and Ecclesiastes 5:3.
c3-ecc-0001: The fastest runner and the strongest soldier both get a mention. Listen to the Preacher in Ecclesiastes 9:11 and Ecclesiastes 9:12.
c3-ecc-0002: A good meal after a long day of work is worth noticing. Sit at the table with the Preacher in Ecclesiastes 2:24 and Ecclesiastes 3:13.
c3-ecc-0003: The Preacher had something to say to young people. Listen to the Preacher's words for the young in Ecclesiastes 11:9 and Ecclesiastes 12:1.
c3-ecc-0004: The Preacher began with a sigh and ended with a final word. Travel from start to close in Ecclesiastes 1:2 and Ecclesiastes 12:13.
c1-sng-0001: Flowers fill the valley in a love song. Find the bride's words in Song of Solomon 2:1.
c2-sng-0001: Out in the vineyard, the young grapes are just starting to show. Look at Song of Solomon 2:15.
c2-sng-0002: Her beloved calls her to come outside with him. Hear his reason in Song of Solomon 2:10 and Song of Solomon 2:11.
c2-sng-0003: The bride is happy and sure of her beloved. Listen to her in Song of Solomon 2:16 and Song of Solomon 2:17.
c3-sng-0001: Twice the bride speaks to the daughters of Jerusalem. Listen to her words in Song of Solomon 2:7 and Song of Solomon 5:8.
c3-sng-0002: Solomon's vineyard brought in silver, but some things can't be bought. Weigh it all in Song of Solomon 8:7 and Song of Solomon 8:11.
c3-sng-0003: The love song keeps reaching for pictures to describe love. Read Song of Solomon 4:10, then Song of Solomon 8:6.
c3-sng-0004: A gazelle leaps over the hills, early and late in the song. Watch it run in Song of Solomon 2:9 and Song of Solomon 8:14.
c1-lam-0001: The city was in ruins, yet the writer still found hope. Find a reason for hope in Lamentations 3:22 and Lamentations 3:23.
c2-lam-0001: A once-busy city sits empty and alone. Hear the writer's sad song in Lamentations 1:1.
c2-lam-0002: The writer felt lost, yet he spoke of the LORD with hope. Hear what his soul says in Lamentations 3:24 and Lamentations 3:25.
c2-lam-0003: The people were ready to come back to God. See what the writer says first in Lamentations 3:40 and Lamentations 3:41.
c3-lam-0001: Sad days had come, but the writer kept thinking about God's kindness. Read Lamentations 3:31, Lamentations 3:32, and Lamentations 3:33.
c3-lam-0002: Jerusalem was crying, and the writer called out from a deep pit. Listen for God's voice drawing near in Lamentations 1:16 and Lamentations 3:57.
c3-lam-0003: Mount Zion lay empty, but the writer looked up. Look up with the writer in Lamentations 3:22 and Lamentations 5:19.
c3-lam-0004: Jerusalem was once called beautiful, and her children were treasured. See what changed for Zion's children in Lamentations 2:15 and Lamentations 4:2.
c1-hos-0001: God gave Hosea a very unusual job. Find out what he did in Hosea 1:3.
c2-hos-0001: God remembers Israel as a little child, loved from the start. Listen in Hosea 11:1.
c2-hos-0002: God speaks kindly to His people out in the wilderness. Walk into the wilderness with Hosea in Hosea 2:14 and Hosea 2:15.
c2-hos-0003: A new day is coming for God's people. Listen to how she speaks to the LORD in Hosea 2:16 and Hosea 2:17.
c3-hos-0001: God remembers holding Ephraim's arms as he learned to walk. Hear Him in Hosea 11:3 and Hosea 11:4.
c3-hos-0002: A little boy was given a sad name, but God had a better plan. Follow the change of names in Hosea 1:9 and Hosea 2:23.
c3-hos-0003: God's heart ached for Ephraim, and then they came home. Hear God's heart for Ephraim in Hosea 11:8 and Hosea 14:8.
c3-hos-0004: Hosea looked ahead to the days when Israel would come back. Look down the road to those days in Hosea 3:5 and Hosea 14:1.
c1-hos-0002: Ephraim had mixed himself in with the nations around him. Hosea speaks in Hosea 7:8.
c2-hos-0004: God asks Ephraim and Judah a sad question. Listen to God's sad question to Ephraim in Hosea 6:4.
c2-hos-0005: Hosea uses a farmer's picture to warn the people. Walk out to Hosea's field in Hosea 8:7 and Hosea 10:13.
c2-hos-0006: Israel ran to other nations for help instead of to the LORD. Hosea paints a picture in Hosea 7:10 and Hosea 7:11.
c3-hos-0005: Hosea calls the people to plant good things and look for the LORD. Notice what else Hosea urges in Hosea 10:12 and Hosea 12:6.
c3-hos-0006: God waited for His people to turn around and come back. Hear their words in Hosea 5:15 and Hosea 6:1.
c3-hos-0007: God speaks about what He really wants from His people. Find what pleases God in Hosea 6:6 and Hosea 13:4.
c3-hos-0008: God remembers finding Israel long ago in a lonely place. Learn how God describes that place in Hosea 9:10 and Hosea 13:5.
c1-jol-0001: Locusts had eaten everything, and Joel called the people back to God. Listen to him in Joel 2:13.
c2-jol-0001: Joel looks sadly at the LORD's vine and fig tree. Stand in Joel's ruined orchard in Joel 1:7.
c2-jol-0002: God promises to pour out His Spirit on everyone. Listen to Joel in Joel 2:28 and Joel 2:29.
c2-jol-0003: The fields were bare, and Joel spoke to the priests. Hear his words in Joel 1:14 and Joel 1:15.
c3-jol-0001: The heavens and the earth will shake when the LORD speaks from Zion. Hear the LORD speak from Zion in Joel 3:16 and Joel 3:17.
c3-jol-0002: A trumpet sounds in Zion, and crowds gather. Find where the crowds are gathered in Joel 2:1 and Joel 3:14.
c3-jol-0003: Four swarms of locusts once ate the land bare. Then God made a promise, in Joel 1:4 and Joel 2:25.
c3-jol-0004: The sun and moon go dark in Joel's words. Look up at Joel 2:31 and Joel 3:15.
c1-amo-0001: Before Amos spoke for the LORD, he had a different job. Find it in Amos 1:1.
c2-amo-0001: The LORD saw how the poor were being treated in Israel. Listen to Him speak in Amos 2:6.
c2-amo-0002: Amos asks one question after another, each one making you think. Begin with Amos 3:3 and Amos 3:4.
c2-amo-0003: Fine homes stood in Israel, some for winter and some for summer. Listen to the LORD in Amos 3:14 and Amos 3:15.
c3-amo-0001: Tough times came again and again in Israel. Notice the words that come after each one in Amos 4:6 and Amos 4:8.
c3-amo-0002: God had known Israel like no other family on earth. Listen to God's call to Israel in Amos 3:2 and Amos 4:12.
c3-amo-0003: A lion's roar makes everyone stop and listen. Hear Amos in Amos 1:2 and Amos 3:8.
c3-amo-0004: Up on the hills of Samaria, the poor were being pushed around. Hear what Amos calls them in Amos 3:9 and Amos 4:1.
c1-amo-0002: In a vision, the Lord stood by a wall and asked Amos a question. Find his reply in Amos 7:7 and Amos 7:8.
c2-amo-0004: The people sang loud songs, but God wanted something more. Listen to Him in Amos 5:23 and Amos 5:24.
c2-amo-0005: Israel was visiting all the wrong places to find God. Hear the LORD in Amos 5:4 and Amos 5:5.
c2-amo-0006: A priest named Amaziah told Amos to leave town. Hear the priest's reason in Amos 7:12 and Amos 7:13.
c3-amo-0005: Some people lay on fancy beds and sipped from big bowls. See what they missed in Amos 6:4 and Amos 6:6.
c3-amo-0006: Amos saw a vision and pleaded with God for Jacob. Listen to him in Amos 7:2 and Amos 9:8.
c3-amo-0007: Amos warns about a very dark day. Learn about the darkening sky in Amos 5:18 and Amos 8:9.
c3-amo-0008: Israel had fallen with no one to help her up. Then comes God's promise, in Amos 5:2 and Amos 9:11.
c1-mic-0001: God's word came to a man named Micah while three kings ruled. See where he lived in Micah 1:1.
c2-mic-0002: Micah looks ahead to a day when nations stop fighting. See what happens to the weapons in Micah 4:3.
c2-mic-0003: Picture a family sitting in the shade of their own vine. Micah describes it in Micah 4:4 and Micah 4:5.
c2-mic-0004: Jerusalem's leaders were doing their jobs for the wrong reasons. Hear Micah in Micah 3:11 and Micah 3:12.
c3-mic-0001: Micah speaks of a Ruler who would come from a small town. Learn more about this Ruler in Micah 5:2 and Micah 5:3.
c3-mic-0002: People lay awake planning wrong things, and Micah felt sad. Listen to Micah's sad words about his day in Micah 2:1 and Micah 7:2.
c3-mic-0003: The temple hill lay bare, yet nations would one day climb it. Notice what the nations say in Micah 3:12 and Micah 4:2.
c3-mic-0004: Leaders were taking gifts, but a true Shepherd was coming. Find out how far His name will reach in Micah 5:4 and Micah 7:3.
c1-mic-0002: God has made it clear what is good. Listen to Micah in Micah 6:8.
c2-mic-0005: God's mercy is bigger than all our wrongs. Micah speaks of it in Micah 7:19.
c2-mic-0006: Micah asks a wonderful question about who God is. Hear Micah's wonder about God in Micah 7:17 and Micah 7:18.
c2-mic-0007: God reminds His people of all He did for them long ago. Listen to God remind His people in Micah 6:3 and Micah 6:4.
c3-mic-0005: Micah speaks right to his enemy, full of hope in God. Listen to Micah answer his enemy in Micah 7:7 and Micah 7:8.
c3-mic-0006: God promised to rescue His people, just like long ago. See what God will show His people in Micah 4:10 and Micah 7:15.
c3-mic-0007: God had a complaint against His people, yet Micah ends with hope. Find God's gift to Jacob in Micah 6:2 and Micah 7:20.
c3-mic-0008: Jacob's family would be like morning dew among many peoples. Learn what God makes of the outcast in Micah 4:7 and Micah 5:7.
c1-hab-0001: Habakkuk cried out to God, wondering why help had not come yet. Hear the prophet's cry in Habakkuk 1:1 and Habakkuk 1:2.
c2-hab-0001: Habakkuk stood on the wall, waiting to hear from God. Hear what God told Habakkuk to do in Habakkuk 2:2.
c2-hab-0002: God told Habakkuk to wait, because the vision would surely come. Listen to how the just shall live in Habakkuk 2:3 and Habakkuk 2:4.
c2-hab-0003: Habakkuk looks ahead to a wonderful day. Picture the whole earth full of His glory in Habakkuk 2:13 and Habakkuk 2:14.
c3-hab-0001: Idols can't speak or breathe at all, but the LORD is different. Learn what all the earth should do in Habakkuk 2:19 and Habakkuk 2:20.
c3-hab-0002: Habakkuk called God his Rock, and later he prayed for help. Hear the end of his prayer in Habakkuk 1:12 and Habakkuk 3:2.
c3-hab-0003: Habakkuk had many questions, and the fields were bare. Hear what he says in Habakkuk 1:3, Habakkuk 3:17, and Habakkuk 3:18.
c3-hab-0004: Habakkuk began by standing watch on the city wall. See how he ends in Habakkuk 2:1 and Habakkuk 3:19.
c1-hag-0001: The temple needed building, and the people were sent up to the hills. Listen to what to bring down from the hills in Haggai 1:8.
c2-hag-0001: The people kept saying it wasn't time yet to build God's house. See where the people were living in Haggai 1:4.
c2-hag-0002: The people worked and worked, yet never seemed to have enough. Hear Haggai in Haggai 1:5 and Haggai 1:6.
c2-hag-0003: The leaders and the people listened to the LORD at last. Hear Haggai's message in Haggai 1:12 and Haggai 1:13.
c3-hag-0001: Some people still remembered how grand the first temple looked. Listen to God's promise about this house in Haggai 2:3 and Haggai 2:9.
c3-hag-0002: The people said the time wasn't right, but then they got to work. Find God's promise in Haggai 1:2 and Haggai 2:19.
c3-hag-0003: The land was dry, and the crops were in trouble. Learn what struck the people's work in Haggai 1:11 and Haggai 2:17.
c3-hag-0004: God stirred up Zerubbabel to lead the building work. See God's final word to him in Haggai 1:14 and Haggai 2:23.
c1-zec-0001: Zechariah's first message called the people back to the LORD. Notice what the LORD promises in Zechariah 1:2 and Zechariah 1:3.
c2-zec-0001: At night, Zechariah saw a man on a red horse. Look closely at Zechariah 1:8.
c2-zec-0002: God calls His people to hurry away from Babylon. Hear His warning in Zechariah 2:7 and Zechariah 2:8.
c2-zec-0003: Joshua the high priest stood in dirty clothes before the Angel. See what came next in Zechariah 3:3 and Zechariah 3:4.
c3-zec-0001: Zerubbabel faced a big building job. The angel brought God's word in Zechariah 4:6 and Zechariah 4:7.
c3-zec-0002: The builders were told to keep their hands strong. Find out what kind of day God speaks of in Zechariah 4:10 and Zechariah 8:9.
c3-zec-0003: God cares deeply for Jerusalem and for Zion. Listen to the new name for Jerusalem in Zechariah 1:14 and Zechariah 8:3.
c3-zec-0004: Many nations will come to know the LORD someday. Watch the nations come in Zechariah 2:11 and Zechariah 8:23.
c1-zec-0002: Jerusalem is told to shout for joy, because her King is coming. Meet the coming King in Zechariah 9:9.
c2-zec-0004: God promises to bring His people out of a dry pit. Hear His call in Zechariah 9:11 and Zechariah 9:12.
c2-zec-0005: Zechariah took two shepherd's staffs and gave each one a name. Learn the names of both staffs in Zechariah 11:7 and Zechariah 11:10.
c2-zec-0006: The nations gathered around Jerusalem. Hear what the LORD says in Zechariah 12:2 and Zechariah 12:3.
c3-zec-0005: Jerusalem was crying, but God had good news coming. Discover what God provides in Zechariah 12:11 and Zechariah 13:1.
c3-zec-0006: Silver gets cleaned in a hot fire to make it pure. See how God tests His people in Zechariah 13:9 and Zechariah 14:9.
c3-zec-0007: A King is coming who speaks kindly to the nations. Listen to what God pours out in Zechariah 9:10 and Zechariah 12:10.
c3-zec-0008: The idols would be gone, and everyday things would belong to God. Find where the holy words are written in Zechariah 13:2 and Zechariah 14:20.
c1-jos-0016: Many kings from the north gathered to fight Joshua. Hear the LORD's plan in Joshua 11:6.
c2-jos-0008: Some cities in Israel were set apart as safe places. Find out why in Joshua 20:2 and Joshua 20:3.
c2-jos-0009: Caleb remembered the day he went to spy out the land. Hear him tell it in Joshua 14:6 and Joshua 14:7.
c2-jos-0010: The tribes by the river built a big altar, and everyone worried. Read how it ends in Joshua 22:33 and Joshua 22:34.
c3-jos-0003: Joshua sent the eastern tribes home with some last words. Listen to Joshua's parting charge in Joshua 22:4 and Joshua 22:5.
c3-jos-0004: Joshua was old now, and the tribes were waiting for their shares. Find what still remained in Joshua 13:1 and Joshua 21:43.
c3-jos-0005: Caleb asked for a mountain where giants once lived. Learn where the giants stayed in Joshua 11:22 and Joshua 14:12.
c3-jos-0006: A man ran to a safe city, and the elders listened. Find where he stood to tell his story in Joshua 20:4 and Joshua 22:30.
c1-2sa-0015: Absalom stood by the city gate early each day, chatting with people. Notice what Absalom wished for in Second Samuel 15:2 and Second Samuel 15:4.
c2-2sa-0003: David got bad news about a wise man who had turned against him. Hear David's prayer in Second Samuel 15:31.
c2-2sa-0004: David told a foreigner named Ittai he could go home. Listen to Ittai's answer in Second Samuel 15:19 and Second Samuel 15:21.
c2-2sa-0005: A man named Shimei shouted at David as he walked by. Listen to David in Second Samuel 16:10 and Second Samuel 16:11.
c3-2sa-0001: Hushai gave Absalom advice about chasing David. Hear his picture of David's men in Second Samuel 17:7 and Second Samuel 17:8.
c3-2sa-0002: David left Jerusalem in a hurry, and friends met him with food. Hear what David's friends said in Second Samuel 15:14 and Second Samuel 17:29.
c3-2sa-0003: Hushai came to meet David on the mountaintop. Picture how Hushai arrived in Second Samuel 15:32 and Second Samuel 17:15.
c3-2sa-0004: David waited for news, and a runner came over the hill. Listen to the watchman's words in Second Samuel 16:12 and Second Samuel 18:27.
c1-2sa-0016: At Gath lived a very tall man, born to the giant. Read about him in Second Samuel 21:20.
c2-2sa-0006: David became tired in battle, and Abishai came to help. Hear his men in Second Samuel 21:16 and Second Samuel 21:17.
c2-2sa-0007: Eleazar stood his ground when the others ran away. Find out what happened in Second Samuel 23:9 and Second Samuel 23:10.
c2-2sa-0008: Shammah would not leave his field, even when everyone fled. Learn about Shammah's field in Second Samuel 23:11 and Second Samuel 23:12.
c3-2sa-0005: Benaiah climbed down into a pit with a lion. Hear about his brave day in Second Samuel 23:20 and Second Samuel 23:22.
c3-2sa-0006: Sickness swept through Israel, and David saw the angel. Hear what David cried to the LORD in Second Samuel 24:15 and Second Samuel 24:17.
c3-2sa-0007: David would not drink the water his brave men brought, and later Araunah made him an offer. Listen to him speak to Araunah in Second Samuel 23:17 and Second Samuel 24:24.
c3-2sa-0008: David became faint in battle; later an angel stood over Jerusalem. Hear the LORD's word to him in Second Samuel 21:15 and Second Samuel 24:16.
c1-1ki-0018: The priests carried the ark into the temple. Find out why they had to stop in First Kings 8:10 and First Kings 8:11.
c2-1ki-0012: The big feast was over, and the people headed home. See how they went in First Kings 8:66.
c2-1ki-0013: Solomon stood in God's new house, amazed at how big God is. Hear his question in First Kings 8:27 and First Kings 8:28.
c2-1ki-0014: Solomon prayed for anyone who would come to God feeling sad. Find what only God knows in First Kings 8:38 and First Kings 8:39.
c3-1ki-0001: King Solomon married women from many lands. Look at God's warning in First Kings 11:2 and First Kings 11:4.
c3-1ki-0002: God warned Solomon, and later He spoke about his kingdom. Learn what was spared in First Kings 9:6 and First Kings 11:13.
c3-1ki-0003: Solomon prayed for the whole world to know God, yet his heart wandered. Count the visits in First Kings 8:60 and First Kings 11:9.
c3-1ki-0004: Solomon spoke of the temple with pride, and God gave a warning. Hear what passersby would do in First Kings 8:13 and First Kings 9:8.
c1-2ki-0006: A watchman on the tower saw chariots coming toward Jezreel. Hear the watchman describe the driving in Second Kings 9:20.
c2-2ki-0018: Elisha sent a young prophet on a secret job with a flask of oil. Find his orders in Second Kings 9:1 and Second Kings 9:3.
c2-2ki-0019: Jehu stepped out to meet the other officers, and they had a question. Hear the officer's question in Second Kings 9:11 and Second Kings 9:12.
c2-2ki-0020: Jehu got rid of Baal, but some old wrongs stayed. Learn which old sins stayed in Second Kings 10:29 and Second Kings 10:31.
c3-2ki-0003: A young prince was brought out of hiding and crowned. See what else the young king received in Second Kings 11:12 and Second Kings 11:13.
c3-2ki-0004: Trumpets sounded for a new king, and in Judah a promise was made. Discover who made it in Second Kings 9:13 and Second Kings 11:17.
c3-2ki-0005: The priest Jehoiada guarded a young king, then later fixed up the temple. Find the money chest in Second Kings 11:4 and Second Kings 12:9.
c3-2ki-0006: Jehu was made king, and God spoke about his family. Listen to God's word about Jehu's sons in Second Kings 9:6 and Second Kings 10:30.
c1-mal-0001: Malachi brings a message from the LORD to Israel. Hear God's first words in Malachi 1:2.
c2-mal-0001: God asks His people a surprising question. Find His answer to them in Malachi 3:8.
c2-mal-0002: Who can stand on the day He comes? Malachi gives two pictures in Malachi 3:2 and Malachi 3:3.
c2-mal-0003: Some people who loved the LORD talked with each other, and God heard them. Find out what was written in Malachi 3:16 and Malachi 3:17.
c3-mal-0001: God speaks to priests who did not treat His name well. Hear God speak about honor in Malachi 1:6 and Malachi 1:7.
c3-mal-0002: The people were tired of waiting for God to act. Listen to God speak about who He is in Malachi 2:17 and Malachi 3:6.
c3-mal-0003: God promised to send a messenger ahead of Him. Find the messenger in Malachi 3:1 and Malachi 4:5.
c3-mal-0004: From sunrise to sunset, God's name will be known. Discover what comes with the rising Sun in Malachi 1:11 and Malachi 4:2.
c1-isa-0006: An ox and a donkey know where they belong. Listen to the LORD in Isaiah 1:3.
c2-isa-0013: Zion was left all alone, like a little shelter in a field. Isaiah paints it in Isaiah 1:8.
c2-isa-0014: The LORD invites His people to come and talk with Him. Hear God's kind invitation in Isaiah 1:18 and Isaiah 1:19.
c2-isa-0015: A loved one planted a vineyard with great care. Hear the song in Isaiah 5:1 and Isaiah 5:2.
c3-isa-0001: The song about the vineyard tells about Israel. Find what the LORD found in Isaiah 5:6 and Isaiah 5:7.
c3-isa-0002: The people felt sick and weak all over. Then comes a call to help, in Isaiah 1:5 and Isaiah 35:3.
c3-isa-0003: Isaiah calls Jacob's family to walk in God's light. Picture the path through the desert in Isaiah 2:5 and Isaiah 35:8.
c3-isa-0004: The people had turned away, but one day they'll come home singing. Listen to the joyful homecoming in Isaiah 1:4 and Isaiah 35:10.
c1-isa-0007: When you're not sure where to turn, Isaiah has good news. Listen for the voice behind you in Isaiah 30:21.
c2-isa-0016: Judah ran to Egypt for help. Isaiah gives a warning in Isaiah 31:1.
c2-isa-0017: The LORD promises to protect Jerusalem. See His picture in Isaiah 31:5 and Isaiah 31:6.
c2-isa-0018: Some people made fun of Isaiah's teaching. Hear the mockers repeat themselves in Isaiah 28:9 and Isaiah 28:10.
c3-isa-0005: Isaiah gave King Hezekiah sad news about the future. Hear the king answer in Isaiah 39:6 and Isaiah 39:8.
c3-isa-0006: An enemy asked Judah who they were trusting. Learn what quiet trust brings in Isaiah 30:15 and Isaiah 36:5.
c3-isa-0007: Some people trusted in the wrong things for safety. Find what those travelers leaned on in Isaiah 28:15 and Isaiah 30:2.
c3-isa-0008: The LORD promised to come down and guard Mount Zion. Listen to why God defends the city in Isaiah 31:4 and Isaiah 37:35.
c1-isa-0008: Isaiah carries a message about the great city of Babylon. Find who God stirs up in Isaiah 13:17.
c2-isa-0019: Babylon was the pride of the kingdoms. Isaiah compares it to other places in Isaiah 13:19.
c2-isa-0020: The whole earth is shaking in Isaiah's vision. Picture the reeling earth in Isaiah 24:19 and Isaiah 24:20.
c2-isa-0021: On the mountain, the LORD sets a big table for everyone. See what's served in Isaiah 25:6 and Isaiah 25:7.
c3-isa-0009: Isaiah looks ahead to a day of gladness for God's people. Notice what the LORD will swallow up in Isaiah 25:8 and Isaiah 25:9.
c3-isa-0010: Voices lift in song, and one mind stays fixed on the LORD. Learn how the LORD keeps that mind in Isaiah 24:14 and Isaiah 26:3.
c3-isa-0011: In Isaiah's words, the lights in the sky go dim. Find where the LORD reigns in Isaiah 13:10 and Isaiah 24:23.
c3-isa-0012: The LORD tells His people to go inside and shut the door. Find how long it lasts in Isaiah 25:5 and Isaiah 26:20.
c1-isa-0009: God introduces His chosen Servant. Listen closely to Isaiah 42:1.
c2-isa-0022: God's Servant is sent out with a special job to do. Learn about the Servant's work in Isaiah 42:6 and Isaiah 42:7.
c2-isa-0023: The Servant says God called Him even before He was born. Hear the Servant describe His mouth in Isaiah 49:1 and Isaiah 49:2.
c2-isa-0024: Each day the Servant listens to the Lord GOD. Listen to Him speak in Isaiah 50:4 and Isaiah 50:5.
c3-isa-0013: Isaiah speaks of comfort for those who are sad. Find the swaps God makes in Isaiah 61:2 and Isaiah 61:3.
c3-isa-0014: God dresses His people in bright new clothes and gives Zion new names. Learn Zion's new names in Isaiah 61:10 and Isaiah 62:4.
c3-isa-0015: God's Servant brings good news to people in chains. Hear the Servant's words to the prisoners in Isaiah 42:6 and Isaiah 49:9.
c3-isa-0016: Someone walks in the dark, and the city walls need guarding. Discover who stands on the walls in Isaiah 50:10 and Isaiah 62:6.
c1-jer-0003: The LORD says a day is coming for Israel and Judah. Hear what God will make with His people in Jeremiah 31:31.
c2-jer-0011: Jeremiah bought a field from his cousin, even in dark times. Count the silver Jeremiah paid in Jeremiah 32:9.
c2-jer-0012: Jeremiah signed papers for the field he bought. See where they were kept in Jeremiah 32:11 and Jeremiah 32:14.
c2-jer-0013: King Zedekiah ran away by night through the king's garden. Follow the story in Jeremiah 39:4 and Jeremiah 39:5.
c3-jer-0005: The king of Babylon gave orders to keep Jeremiah safe. Find who looked after Jeremiah in Jeremiah 39:12 and Jeremiah 39:14.
c3-jer-0006: Two men were cared for by kings of Babylon, years apart. Follow both of their stories in Jeremiah 39:12, Jeremiah 52:32, and Jeremiah 52:33.
c3-jer-0007: God promised to forgive, and Jeremiah bought land as a sign of hope. Hear God's promise for the land in Jeremiah 31:34 and Jeremiah 32:15.
c3-jer-0008: Jerusalem faced a long, sad siege. Look at the dates in Jeremiah 39:2 and Jeremiah 52:6.
c1-jer-0004: God handed Jeremiah something to carry to the nations. Find what God handed him in Jeremiah 25:15.
c2-jer-0014: Baruch, Jeremiah's helper, felt very low. Hear Baruch's sad words in Jeremiah 45:2 and Jeremiah 45:3.
c2-jer-0015: Baruch wanted big things for himself, and God answered him. Hear what God gave Baruch in Jeremiah 45:4 and Jeremiah 45:5.
c2-jer-0016: Egypt was hurt and looking for help. Listen to the LORD's words in Jeremiah 46:11 and Jeremiah 46:12.
c3-jer-0009: The LORD uses a farm picture to describe Egypt. Picture Egypt the way God describes her in Jeremiah 46:20 and Jeremiah 46:21.
c3-jer-0010: Jeremiah's words against Babylon were written on a scroll. See what happened to it in Jeremiah 25:13, Jeremiah 51:63, and Jeremiah 51:64.
c3-jer-0011: Two of Jeremiah's messages came in the very same year. Learn which king ruled that year in Jeremiah 25:1 and Jeremiah 45:1.
c3-jer-0012: The King of all swears by tall mountains. Hear God name His tool in Jeremiah 46:18 and Jeremiah 51:20.
c1-ezk-0003: The hand of the Lord fell on Ezekiel while he sat at home. Learn how Ezekiel was lifted in Ezekiel 8:3.
c2-ezk-0011: Ezekiel stood at the north gate and saw women crying. Find who the women cried for in Ezekiel 8:14.
c2-ezk-0012: A man dressed in linen walked through Jerusalem. Find his job in Ezekiel 9:3 and Ezekiel 9:4.
c2-ezk-0013: Ezekiel saw amazing heavenly beings, each with four faces. Learn about the faces in Ezekiel 10:14 and Ezekiel 10:21.
c3-ezk-0005: Some leaders were giving bad advice in the city. Hear the leaders' proud words in Ezekiel 11:2 and Ezekiel 11:3.
c3-ezk-0006: God's people were scattered far away in other lands. Listen to God's promise to the scattered in Ezekiel 11:16 and Ezekiel 43:5.
c3-ezk-0007: God's glory left the city and later came back. Watch the glory return in Ezekiel 11:23 and Ezekiel 43:2.
c3-ezk-0008: Water trickled from the temple, and a man measured it step by step. Wade in with Ezekiel in Ezekiel 10:4, Ezekiel 47:4, and Ezekiel 47:5.
c1-dan-0018: Daniel saw four big beasts come up out of the sea. Look at the first in Daniel 7:3 and Daniel 7:4.
c2-dan-0006: The second beast looked like a bear. See what the bear held in Daniel 7:5.
c2-dan-0007: In a night vision, Daniel saw someone coming. Hear about the One like the Son of Man in Daniel 7:13 and Daniel 7:14.
c2-dan-0008: A ram and a goat appeared in Daniel's vision. Find out what the goat stands for in Daniel 8:20 and Daniel 8:21.
c3-dan-0003: Daniel stood by the river, trying to understand the vision. Find who was called to help Daniel in Daniel 8:15 and Daniel 8:16.
c3-dan-0004: Daniel was told to seal up the vision for later. Notice what happens at the time of the end in Daniel 8:26 and Daniel 12:4.
c3-dan-0005: Horns kept showing up in Daniel's visions. Learn what the horns mean in Daniel 7:24 and Daniel 8:20.
c3-dan-0006: A heavenly messenger came to Daniel more than once. Hear how the messenger speaks of Daniel in Daniel 9:23 and Daniel 10:11.
c1-psa-0020: The first psalm compares two kinds of people. Find out what the others are like in Psalm 1:4.
c2-psa-0018: The psalmist says not to worry about people who do wrong. Find who will inherit the earth in Psalm 37:11.
c2-psa-0019: Psalm 37 talks about a good man's walk. Hear about a good man's steps in Psalm 37:23 and Psalm 37:24.
c2-psa-0020: Someone gets very rich, and the psalmist says not to be afraid. See what he takes along in Psalm 49:16 and Psalm 49:17.
c3-psa-0006: The psalmist was puzzled by unfair things he saw. See where he went in Psalm 73:16 and Psalm 73:17.
c3-psa-0007: The psalmist almost slipped, but he found a sure place to stand. Hear about a heart that trusts in Psalm 73:2 and Psalm 112:7.
c3-psa-0008: Two psalms describe someone who loves God's law. Listen to what comes from the mouth of the righteous in Psalm 1:2 and Psalm 37:30.
c3-psa-0009: Two psalms speak of not understanding, in different ways. Hear the psalmist describe himself in Psalm 49:20 and Psalm 73:22.
c1-psa-0021: The sea ran away and the river turned back in Psalm 114. Watch the mountains move in Psalm 114:4.
c2-psa-0021: Psalm 121 talks about the One who keeps Israel. Learn what our Keeper never does in Psalm 121:3 and Psalm 121:4.
c2-psa-0022: Builders looked at a stone and tossed it aside. See what happened in Psalm 118:22 and Psalm 118:23.
c2-psa-0023: The psalmist prays for God to bring His people home. Hear about those who plant in tears in Psalm 126:4 and Psalm 126:5.
c3-psa-0010: Brothers and sisters living as one is a good thing. Find out where the dew falls in Psalm 133:1, Psalm 133:2, and Psalm 133:3.
c3-psa-0011: Servants look to their master's hand, and someone waits through the night. Wait with the psalmist in Psalm 123:2 and Psalm 130:6.
c3-psa-0012: Trusting God is better than trusting people. Hear why Israel can trust the LORD in Psalm 115:9 and Psalm 118:8.
c3-psa-0013: The LORD cut through the ropes of the wicked. Listen to how the soul got away in Psalm 124:7 and Psalm 129:4.
c1-pro-0019: Picture beautiful silver work around something lovely. The proverb is in Proverbs 25:11.
c2-pro-0013: A king learned wise words from his mother. Find his name in Proverbs 31:1.
c2-pro-0014: Some of Solomon's sayings were copied down much later. Find who copied them in Proverbs 25:1 and Proverbs 25:3.
c2-pro-0015: Imagine getting good news from far away. Look at the proverb in Proverbs 25:25 and Proverbs 25:26.
c3-pro-0004: A man named Agur asks God for two things. Listen to Agur's two requests in Proverbs 30:7 and Proverbs 30:8.
c3-pro-0005: Guarding your heart takes care every day. Picture a man with no rule over his spirit in Proverbs 4:23 and Proverbs 25:28.
c3-pro-0006: The proverbs call wisdom worth searching for. Notice how to search for wisdom in Proverbs 2:4 and Proverbs 4:7.
c3-pro-0007: Agur felt he knew so little about God. Learn about the glory of kings in Proverbs 25:2 and Proverbs 30:3.
c1-job-0005: Eliphaz speaks to Job about trouble in life. Hear the picture Eliphaz uses in Job 5:7.
c2-job-0013: Bildad talks about people who forget God. Read his picture in Job 8:14.
c2-job-0014: Eliphaz asks Job some big questions. Listen to what Eliphaz asks next in Job 15:7 and Job 15:8.
c2-job-0015: A young man named Elihu got upset with Job and his friends. Meet him in Job 32:2 and Job 32:3.
c3-job-0001: Elihu had so much to say he could hardly hold it in. Notice how Elihu describes himself in Job 32:18 and Job 32:19.
c3-job-0002: Eliphaz and Elihu both speak about how people are made. Hear Elihu speak about himself in Job 4:17 and Job 33:6.
c3-job-0003: Zophar and Elihu both wonder at how deep God is. Learn what cannot be found out in Job 11:7 and Job 36:26.
c3-job-0004: Job's friends try to cheer him up with talk about the future. Hear Bildad's words about Job's later days in Job 5:17 and Job 8:7.
c1-mat-0036: An angel spoke to Joseph about a baby's name. Find out what that name means in Matthew 1:23.
c2-mat-0018: Jesus and His friends were walking toward Jerusalem near the Mount of Olives. Find the village they reached in Matthew 21:1.
c2-mat-0019: Matthew remembers an old, sad word from Jeremiah. Hear the voice from Ramah in Matthew 2:17 and Matthew 2:18.
c2-mat-0020: As evening came, many people were brought to Jesus for help. See how Jesus helped them in Matthew 8:16 and Matthew 8:17.
c3-mat-0004: Jesus left for Galilee after hearing some news. Find the news Jesus heard in Matthew 4:12 and Matthew 4:13.
c3-mat-0005: Great crowds came, and Jesus healed them all. Hear what Jesus told the crowds in Matthew 8:17 and Matthew 12:16.
c3-mat-0006: Matthew points to old words about a coming King. Learn who the Ruler will shepherd in Matthew 2:6 and Matthew 21:5.
c3-mat-0007: Matthew quotes Jeremiah twice in his book. Find what the coins paid for in Matthew 2:17 and Matthew 27:10.
c1-mat-0037: The King sits on His throne with all the nations before Him. See where the sheep are placed in Matthew 25:33.
c2-mat-0021: Ten young women waited a long time for the bridegroom. See what happened in Matthew 25:5.
c2-mat-0022: A man went on a long trip and left money with his servants. Learn how it was handed out in Matthew 25:14 and Matthew 25:15.
c2-mat-0023: Jesus points to a fig tree for a lesson. Listen to what the leafy branch teaches in Matthew 24:32 and Matthew 24:33.
c3-mat-0008: The King thanks people for the kind things they did for Him. Notice what the King remembers in Matthew 25:35 and Matthew 25:36.
c3-mat-0009: Jesus says to keep watching, twice over. Learn what we don't know in Matthew 24:42 and Matthew 25:13.
c3-mat-0010: A homeowner stays alert, and some friends go in to a wedding feast. See what happened next in Matthew 24:43 and Matthew 25:10.
c3-mat-0011: The Son of Man comes with all His angels. Hear how the angels are sent in Matthew 24:31 and Matthew 25:31.
c1-luk-0037: A woman loses one of her ten silver coins. See what she does in Luke 15:8.
c2-luk-0009: A rich farmer had more crops than he had room for. Listen to his plan in Luke 12:18.
c2-luk-0010: People were invited to a big supper, but the excuses started. Hear the second guest's excuse in Luke 14:18 and Luke 14:19.
c2-luk-0011: A sneaky manager talked to the people who owed his master. Find the number the manager gave in Luke 16:5 and Luke 16:6.
c3-luk-0002: Two men went up to the temple to pray. Watch the second one in Luke 18:10 and Luke 18:13.
c3-luk-0003: Jesus speaks about money and what we serve. Hear what we cannot serve along with God in Luke 12:21 and Luke 16:13.
c3-luk-0004: A master fills his supper table, and a woman finds what she lost. See who the woman calls in Luke 14:21 and Luke 15:9.
c3-luk-0005: Jesus told stories about two rich men. Listen to what the second rich man asks for in Luke 12:16 and Luke 16:2.
c1-luk-0038: Jesus talks about following Him without looking back. Hear Jesus' words about looking back in Luke 9:62.
c2-luk-0012: Ten men with a skin sickness called out to Jesus. Hear His answer in Luke 17:14.
c2-luk-0013: Jesus sent seventy helpers out ahead of Him. Listen to what He told them in Luke 10:2 and Luke 10:3.
c2-luk-0014: Jesus felt sad over Jerusalem. Listen to His words in Luke 13:34 and Luke 13:35.
c3-luk-0006: A woman in the synagogue was bent over and couldn't stand up straight. Learn how long she had suffered in Luke 13:11 and Luke 13:16.
c3-luk-0007: Jesus set out on the road to Jerusalem. Follow Him in Luke 9:51 and Luke 17:11.
c3-luk-0008: Jesus speaks about little children and the Father's ways. Hear Jesus pray to His Father in Luke 10:21 and Luke 18:17.
c3-luk-0009: One Samaritan village turned Jesus away, but another Samaritan acted very differently. Watch the Samaritan at Jesus' feet in Luke 9:53 and Luke 17:16.
c1-mrk-0023: Jesus came home and taught, and the people there were upset. Hear them in Mark 6:3.
c2-mrk-0007: Jesus asks a question about where a lamp belongs. Listen to Jesus' question about the lamp in Mark 4:21.
c2-mrk-0008: Some leaders cared more about their own rules than God's. Learn the word those leaders used in Mark 7:9 and Mark 7:11.
c2-mrk-0009: Jesus tells how a farmer's field gives its crop little by little. Watch the field change step by step in Mark 4:28 and Mark 4:29.
c3-mrk-0003: A dad brought his son to Jesus, hoping for help. Hear their talk in Mark 9:17 and Mark 9:21.
c3-mrk-0004: Some people near Jesus didn't understand Him. Hear Jesus speak about a prophet in Mark 3:21 and Mark 6:4.
c3-mrk-0005: Jesus sent out His disciples, and later told a story about a trip. Find who is told to watch in Mark 6:7 and Mark 13:34.
c3-mrk-0006: Religious leaders kept finding fault with Jesus. Listen to the leaders' complaint in Mark 3:22 and Mark 7:5.
c1-jhn-0033: A wedding party was happening in the town of Cana. Look around in John 2:6.
c2-jhn-0016: A man lay by a pool in Jerusalem, waiting for help. Learn how long he had waited in John 5:5.
c2-jhn-0017: A huge crowd was hungry, and Jesus asked Philip a question. Find out why Jesus asked in John 6:5 and John 6:6.
c2-jhn-0018: Jesus put clay on a man's eyes and gave him a job. Follow the man where Jesus sent him in John 9:6 and John 9:7.
c3-jhn-0003: A worried father asked his servants about his sick son. Hear the servants' answer in John 4:52 and John 4:53.
c3-jhn-0004: Jesus saw a man by the road who could not see. Learn about this man's life in John 9:1 and John 11:37.
c3-jhn-0005: John keeps track of the signs Jesus did. Hear what John calls each sign in John 2:11 and John 4:54.
c3-jhn-0006: Two men were healed by Jesus, in two different places. Notice when both healings happened in John 5:9 and John 9:14.
c1-jhn-0034: It was winter, and Jesus walked in the temple during a feast. Find where Jesus walked in John 10:22 and John 10:23.
c2-jhn-0019: Officers came back to the leaders empty-handed. Listen to their answer in John 7:45 and John 7:46.
c2-jhn-0020: Some people close to Jesus told Him to go show Himself. Find out who said those words in John 7:3 and John 7:5.
c2-jhn-0021: The crowd argued with Jesus about who they were. Hear the crowd's claim in John 8:33 and John 8:39.
c3-jhn-0007: Some people picked up stones, angry at Jesus. Hear the angry crowd's reason in John 10:33 and John 10:34.
c3-jhn-0008: People remembered John the Baptist, and Jesus spoke about him too. Listen to how Jesus describes John in John 5:35 and John 10:41.
c3-jhn-0009: Jesus talks about how to judge fairly. Learn how Jesus says to judge in John 5:30 and John 7:24.
c3-jhn-0010: Twice people wanted to grab Jesus, but no one did. Find the reason no hand touched Him in John 7:30 and John 8:20.
c1-act-0032: After the shipwreck, everyone made it safely to land. Find the island's name in Acts 28:1.
c2-act-0015: Paul gathered sticks for a warm fire on the beach. Watch the campfire closely in Acts 28:3.
c2-act-0016: Someone overheard a plan against Paul and hurried to tell him. Find out who brought Paul the warning in Acts 23:16 and Acts 23:24.
c2-act-0017: The commander told Paul how much he paid to become a Roman. Hear Paul's reply in Acts 22:27 and Acts 22:28.
c3-act-0003: Paul talked with Felix about doing right and the days ahead. Hear Felix in Acts 24:24 and Acts 24:25.
c3-act-0004: Festus listened to Paul, then spoke up loudly. Listen to what Festus shouted in Acts 25:19 and Acts 26:24.
c3-act-0005: Paul faced scary nights, and the Lord spoke to him. Hear the Lord's first words to Paul in Acts 23:11 and Acts 27:24.
c3-act-0006: Paul spent long stretches of time waiting. Find where Paul stayed in Acts 24:27 and Acts 28:30.
c1-rom-0018: Paul finishes a long section with a burst of praise. Join Paul's praise in Romans 11:33.
c2-rom-0007: Paul speaks about God's gifts and His calling. Learn about God's gifts in Romans 11:29.
c2-rom-0008: Paul asks a big question about Israel, then answers it. Hear Paul's answer in Romans 11:11 and Romans 11:12.
c2-rom-0009: Israel was always close to Paul's heart. Listen to what he says about them in Romans 10:1 and Romans 10:2.
c3-rom-0003: Paul thinks about his own people, and his heart is heavy. Feel Paul's heart for his people in Romans 9:2 and Romans 9:3.
c3-rom-0004: Paul speaks of God's patience and His ways. Find out what God shows in Romans 9:22 and Romans 11:22.
c3-rom-0005: Paul asks who can talk back to God. Hear Paul's next question in Romans 9:20 and Romans 11:34.
c3-rom-0006: Paul talks about people being sent with good news. Hear what Paul calls himself in Romans 10:15 and Romans 11:13.
c1-rom-0019: Paul asks what good thing the Jewish people were given. Find his answer in Romans 3:1 and Romans 3:2.
c2-rom-0010: Paul says the world around us points to God. Learn what that means for people in Romans 1:20.
c2-rom-0011: Some people told lies about what Paul taught. Listen to Paul answer the rumor in Romans 3:7 and Romans 3:8.
c2-rom-0012: Paul writes to someone proud of knowing the law. Notice what that person is sure of in Romans 2:17 and Romans 2:19.
c3-rom-0007: Paul looks back at Abraham's story. Find out what Abraham became in Romans 4:10 and Romans 4:11.
c3-rom-0008: Some people forgot God, but Abraham held on to His promise. See how Abraham held on in Romans 1:21 and Romans 4:20.
c3-rom-0009: Paul asks where bragging fits in. Hear why the law speaks in Romans 3:19 and Romans 3:27.
c3-rom-0010: Paul says there's no difference among people before God. Learn what God never shows in Romans 2:11 and Romans 3:22.
c1-rom-0020: Near the end of Romans, someone new says hello. Meet the man who wrote the letter down in Romans 16:22.
c2-rom-0013: Paul tells believers to pay attention to the time. Find out what time it is in Romans 13:11.
c2-rom-0014: Paul talks about paying taxes and treating leaders well. Find out what we owe others in Romans 13:6 and Romans 13:7.
c2-rom-0015: Priscilla and Aquila were Paul's good friends and helpers. Listen to what this couple did for Paul in Romans 16:3 and Romans 16:4.
c3-rom-0011: Paul prays for believers to get along with each other. Hear Paul's call to the church in Romans 15:5 and Romans 15:7.
c3-rom-0012: Paul talks about why the old Scriptures were written down. Discover the reason for those old words in Romans 15:4 and Romans 16:26.
c3-rom-0013: Paul encourages believers to live kindly with everyone. Hear where Satan will be crushed in Romans 12:18 and Romans 16:20.
c3-rom-0014: Paul mentions leaders and a man named Erastus. Learn Erastus's job in Romans 13:1 and Romans 16:23.
c1-1co-0009: Paul faced many rough days in the city of Ephesus. Hear about Paul's fight in First Corinthians 15:32.
c2-1co-0007: Paul remembers the harm he did to the church before he knew Jesus. Listen to what Paul calls himself in First Corinthians 15:9.
c2-1co-0008: Paul lists the people who saw Jesus alive again. Hear about Paul's own meeting with Jesus in First Corinthians 15:7 and First Corinthians 15:8.
c2-1co-0009: Paul writes about hope in Christ. Notice what he says about hope in this life only in First Corinthians 15:17 and First Corinthians 15:19.
c3-1co-0003: Paul uses a farmer's planting to explain new life. Watch what happens to a planted grain in First Corinthians 15:36 and First Corinthians 15:37.
c3-1co-0004: Paul asks what follows if Christ was not raised. Hear what believers can know about their work in First Corinthians 15:14 and First Corinthians 15:58.
c3-1co-0005: Paul compares Adam with Christ. Learn what the last Adam became in First Corinthians 15:22 and First Corinthians 15:45.
c3-1co-0006: Paul talks about the day the dead are raised. Listen to how quickly the change comes in First Corinthians 15:12 and First Corinthians 15:52.
c1-2co-0002: Paul tells about a man who had an amazing experience long ago. Find where that man was taken in Second Corinthians 12:2.
c2-2co-0006: God comforts us when life gets heavy. Find out what that lets us do in Second Corinthians 1:4.
c2-2co-0007: Paul didn't need anyone to write good things about him. Notice how he describes the Corinthians in Second Corinthians 3:2 and Second Corinthians 3:3.
c2-2co-0008: Paul remembers a close call in the city of Damascus. Find which king ruled there in Second Corinthians 11:31 and Second Corinthians 11:32.
c3-2co-0003: Believers are in a different kind of battle. Learn about our weapons in Second Corinthians 10:3 and Second Corinthians 10:4.
c3-2co-0004: Paul speaks honestly about sharing God's word. Learn what brings death and what gives life in Second Corinthians 2:17 and Second Corinthians 3:6.
c3-2co-0005: Paul faced danger on land and sea. Hear what Paul felt inside during his trouble in Second Corinthians 1:9 and Second Corinthians 11:26.
c3-2co-0006: Some people had unkind things to say about Paul. Listen to what some said about his speaking in Second Corinthians 10:10 and Second Corinthians 12:6.
c1-heb-0003: Melchizedek was a king and a priest. Learn about his names in Hebrews 7:1 and Hebrews 7:2.
c2-heb-0007: Hebrews begins by describing the Son of God. Learn what else the Son is called in Hebrews 1:3.
c2-heb-0008: The old priests came and went, one after another. Compare them to Jesus in Hebrews 7:23 and Hebrews 7:24.
c2-heb-0009: Moses sprinkled the tabernacle as God commanded. Notice why the blood mattered in Hebrews 9:21 and Hebrews 9:22.
c3-heb-0001: The old sacrifices were offered year after year. Find out what the worshipers would have stopped having in Hebrews 10:1 and Hebrews 10:2.
c3-heb-0002: Jesus prayed to His Father while He lived on earth. Hear how Jesus prayed in Hebrews 5:7 and Hebrews 10:7.
c3-heb-0003: Jesus entered the Most Holy Place once for all. Learn what blood Jesus brought in Hebrews 7:27 and Hebrews 9:12.
c3-heb-0004: Our High Priest sits beside God's throne. Discover how He made His people complete in Hebrews 8:1 and Hebrews 10:14.
c1-heb-0004: Hebrews tells us to pay close attention to what we've heard. Find out why in Hebrews 2:1.
c2-heb-0010: The writer asks questions about the people who left Egypt. Find who could not enter God's rest in Hebrews 3:16 and Hebrews 3:18.
c2-heb-0011: God's word is sharp, and He sees everything. Listen to what we must do before Him in Hebrews 4:12 and Hebrews 4:13.
c2-heb-0012: Hebrews talks about welcoming strangers and caring for prisoners. Find out how to remember those in prison in Hebrews 13:2 and Hebrews 13:3.
c3-heb-0005: Moms and dads correct their children, and so does our heavenly Father. Notice why the Father corrects us in Hebrews 12:9 and Hebrews 12:10.
c3-heb-0006: Believers are told to cheer each other on. Look at Hebrews 3:13, Hebrews 10:24, and Hebrews 10:25.
c3-heb-0007: Hebrews talks about faith and patience over a long stretch. Learn what faithful people receive in Hebrews 6:12 and Hebrews 10:36.
c3-heb-0008: Hold on to your trust in Christ, Hebrews says. Find out how to hold our confidence in Hebrews 3:14 and Hebrews 10:35.
c1-rev-0007: The fifth seal was broken, and John saw something new. Find where the souls were in Revelation 6:9.
c2-rev-0020: An angel handed John a little book. Stay with John as he takes the book in Revelation 10:9 and Revelation 10:10.
c2-rev-0021: Some souls in heaven cried out, asking how long. See what each soul was given in Revelation 6:10 and Revelation 6:11.
c2-rev-0022: A mighty angel stood with one foot on the sea and one on land. Hear the angel's promise in Revelation 10:5 and Revelation 10:6.
c3-rev-0002: Kings and ordinary people ran to the mountain caves. Listen to their cry to the rocks in Revelation 6:15 and Revelation 6:16.
c3-rev-0003: People ran to the caves, and then a trumpet sounded in heaven. Hear the loud voices in heaven in Revelation 6:15 and Revelation 11:15.
c3-rev-0004: Voices like thunder spoke to John. Hear what John was told to do in Revelation 6:1 and Revelation 10:4.
c3-rev-0005: People on earth were afraid, but the elders in heaven bowed low. Bow with the elders in Revelation 6:17, Revelation 11:16, and Revelation 11:17.
c1-col-0001: The believers in Colosse first heard about Jesus from a friend of Paul. Meet him in Colossians 1:7.
c2-col-0001: Paul sends hellos from his friends Luke and Demas. Learn about Luke in Colossians 4:14.
c2-col-0002: Whatever job we have each day, Paul has a word about it. Listen to how to work in Colossians 3:23 and Colossians 3:24.
c2-col-0003: Some people made lots of rules about touching and tasting. Learn what happens to those things in Colossians 2:21 and Colossians 2:22.
c3-col-0001: Paul says to keep our minds on things above. Find where our life is in Colossians 3:2 and Colossians 3:3.
c3-col-0002: Paul writes about rulers and powers, seen and unseen. Notice what Christ did with those powers in Colossians 1:16 and Colossians 2:15.
c3-col-0003: Christ was before everything, and Paul names all kinds of people. Hear who Christ is in Colossians 1:17 and Colossians 3:11.
c3-col-0004: Paul is far away, but his heart is with the Colossians. Find out what made Paul glad in Colossians 1:23 and Colossians 2:5.
c1-1th-0001: People everywhere talked about how the Thessalonians turned to God. Learn what they turned from in First Thessalonians 1:9.
c2-1th-0001: Paul remembers how kind he was with the believers in Thessalonica. Listen to Paul's picture of kindness in First Thessalonians 2:7.
c2-1th-0002: Paul really wanted to visit his friends. Find out why he couldn't come in First Thessalonians 2:17 and First Thessalonians 2:18.
c2-1th-0003: Paul is so thankful for his friends. Notice what he prays for night and day in First Thessalonians 3:9 and First Thessalonians 3:10.
c3-1th-0001: Paul writes to friends who missed loved ones who had died. Hear Paul's comfort in First Thessalonians 4:13 and First Thessalonians 4:14.
c3-1th-0002: Paul prays for more love among the believers. Find out why he didn't need to write it in First Thessalonians 3:12 and First Thessalonians 4:9.
c3-1th-0003: Paul talks about what God has planned for His people. Find what God appointed us to in First Thessalonians 1:10 and First Thessalonians 5:9.
c3-1th-0004: Paul talks about how believers live in front of others. Learn how to walk before others in First Thessalonians 2:12 and First Thessalonians 4:12.
c1-2th-0001: Paul reminds the believers of a rule about work. Listen to the rule in Second Thessalonians 3:10.
c2-2th-0001: Paul picks up the pen himself at the close. See what he says about his greeting in Second Thessalonians 3:17.
c2-2th-0002: Some people were upset by strange news about the Lord. Find the false claim in Second Thessalonians 2:1 and Second Thessalonians 2:2.
c2-2th-0003: Paul tells the church how to treat someone who won't listen. Notice how to treat him in Second Thessalonians 3:14 and Second Thessalonians 3:15.
c3-2th-0001: Paul wanted to set a good example for the Thessalonians. Learn how he ate his bread in Second Thessalonians 3:8 and Second Thessalonians 3:9.
c3-2th-0002: Thankful for God's gifts, Paul prays for his friends. Discover what God has given us in Second Thessalonians 2:16 and Second Thessalonians 3:16.
c3-2th-0003: Paul's friends were going through trouble, and God had called them. Find what He called them to in Second Thessalonians 1:5 and Second Thessalonians 2:14.
c3-2th-0004: Prayer goes both ways in this letter. Hear Paul's request in Second Thessalonians 1:11 and Second Thessalonians 3:1.
c1-1ti-0001: Paul shares a true saying worth remembering. Learn who Jesus came to save in First Timothy 1:15.
c2-1ti-0001: Timothy was young, and Paul cheered him on. Listen to what Timothy could be in First Timothy 4:12.
c2-1ti-0002: Paul talks about caring for family at home. Hear Paul's warning about family care in First Timothy 5:4 and First Timothy 5:8.
c2-1ti-0003: We came into the world with nothing, Paul says. Find out what contentment brings in First Timothy 6:6 and First Timothy 6:7.
c3-1ti-0001: Paul tells Timothy to keep reading and teaching. Hear what Timothy's progress should be in First Timothy 4:13 and First Timothy 4:15.
c3-1ti-0002: Paul urges Timothy to keep fighting the fight of faith. Learn what to keep along with faith in First Timothy 1:19 and First Timothy 6:12.
c3-1ti-0003: Paul writes to Timothy about the church and the living God. Hear how Paul describes the church in First Timothy 3:15 and First Timothy 4:10.
c3-1ti-0004: Paul remembers words spoken over young Timothy. Find what Timothy shouldn't neglect in First Timothy 1:18 and First Timothy 4:14.
c1-tit-0001: Paul gave Titus an important job on an island. Find where Titus was left in Titus 1:5.
c2-tit-0001: Paul was making plans for the cold months ahead. Find where Paul wanted to meet Titus in Titus 3:12.
c2-tit-0002: Paul tells Titus to set a good example. Find out why sound speech matters in Titus 2:7 and Titus 2:8.
c2-tit-0003: Paul warns Titus about silly arguments. Learn when to turn away a divisive man in Titus 3:9 and Titus 3:10.
c3-tit-0001: Paul says Jesus gave Himself for us. Notice what we are looking for in Titus 2:13 and Titus 2:14.
c3-tit-0002: God's grace and kindness came to us in Jesus. Find out how God saved us in Titus 2:11, Titus 3:4, and Titus 3:5.
c3-tit-0003: Paul writes about God's promise from before time began. Hear how Paul describes God in Titus 1:2 and Titus 3:7.
c3-tit-0004: Paul calls Titus his true son, and gives him a job to do. Learn how Titus is to speak in Titus 1:4 and Titus 2:15.
c1-2pe-0001: Peter knew his time on earth would end soon. Listen to what Peter must put off in Second Peter 1:14.
c2-2pe-0001: Peter remembers hearing the Father speak about Jesus. Find where the Father's voice came from in Second Peter 1:17.
c2-2pe-0002: Peter warns about teachers who say one thing but live another. Learn what those teachers really are in Second Peter 2:17 and Second Peter 2:19.
c2-2pe-0003: Peter says some people will laugh at the promise of Jesus' coming. Hear the scoffers' claim in Second Peter 3:3 and Second Peter 3:4.
c3-2pe-0001: Peter talks about good things to add to our faith. Hear about one who lacks these things in Second Peter 1:9 and Second Peter 1:10.
c3-2pe-0002: Peter likes to remind his friends of what they know. Learn what Peter hopes to stir up in Second Peter 1:13 and Second Peter 3:1.
c3-2pe-0003: Peter warns believers to stay on guard. Hear Peter's warning in Second Peter 2:1 and Second Peter 3:17.
c3-2pe-0004: Peter says the apostles saw Jesus with their own eyes. Find out what the apostles didn't follow in Second Peter 1:16 and Second Peter 2:3.
